Created by 马士杰 on 七月 11, 2024

# 1. 需求概述

  [https://pingcode.yasdb.com/pjm/items/66191587fd997db58ad89342](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/pjm/items/66191587fd997db58ad89342)    ?    
  #YDBRD-26280 支持MySQL Show语句

SHOW CHARSET    
  SHOW CHARACTER SET    
  SHOW COLUMNS FROM `test`.`test_view`    
  SHOW COLLATION    
  SHOW CREATE PROCEDURE `test`.`TEST_PRO`    
  SHOW CREATE VIEW `test_view`    
  SHOW CREATE TABLE `test`.`test`    
  SHOW CREATE DATABASE test    
  SHOW CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS `mysql`    
  SHOW CREATE TRIGGER test1.TEST    
  SHOW DATABASES    
  SHOW ENGINES    
  show fields from `columns_priv`    
  SHOW FULL COLUMNS FROM `newtable`    
  SHOW FULL PROCESSLIST    
  SHOW FULL TABLES FROM TEST1    
  SHOW FULL TABLES WHERE Table_type = 'VIEW'    
  SHOW FULL TABLES FROM test1 WHERE Tables_in_test1 = 'newtable'    
  SHOW FUNCTION STATUS WHERE Db = 'test'    
  SHOW PROCEDURE STATUS WHERE Db = 'test'    
  SHOW PROCESSLIST    
  SHOW INDEX FROM `newtable`    
  SHOW GLOBAL STATUS    
  SHOW GLOBAL VARIABLES    
  SHOW GRANTS FOR 'yasdb'@'192.168.132.53'    
  SHOW MASTER STATUS    
  SHOW PLUGINS    
  SHOW TRIGGERS LIKE 'user'    
  SHOW TABLE STATUS    
  SHOW STATUS    
  SHOW SLAVE STATUS    
  SHOW TABLES    
  SHOW TABLE STATUS LIKE    
  SHOW TABLE STATUS FROM test    
  SHOW TABLE STATUS FROM test1 LIKE 'newtable'    
  SHOW VARIABLES    
  SHOW VARIABLES LIKE 'lower_case_table_names'    
  SELECT CURRENT_USER();    
  SELECT DATABASE()

  


# 2. 示例

1、显示格式

支持show xx \G

![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739c00b8970c2af4f533a79/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..pPtqcigDTDoq4ACAd-fZCS6z1OljlZwEFvOXY0k_3Nw)

2、需求范围内的命令示例

|编号|show命令|功能|权限要求|示例|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|1|SHOW CHARSET|显示字符集,SHOW   {  CHARACTER     SET     |     CHARSET  }   [  LIKE     '  *pattern*  '     |     WHERE     *expr*  ]|无|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739c00b8970c2af4f533a7a/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..pPtqcigDTDoq4ACAd-fZCS6z1OljlZwEFvOXY0k_3Nw)|
|2|SHOW CHARACTER SET|显示字符集，和CHARSET同意|无|同上|
|3|SHOW COLUMNS FROM `test`.`test_view`|显示表的列定义信息,SHOW     [  FULL  ]   {  COLUMNS     |     FIELDS  }   {  FROM     |     IN  }   *tbl_name*     [  {  FROM     |     IN  }   *db_name*  ]     [  LIKE     '  *pattern*  '     |     WHERE     *expr*  ]|拥有该列权限（查询）,grant   **select**   on test_db01.* to regress;|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739c00b8970c2af4f533a7c/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..pPtqcigDTDoq4ACAd-fZCS6z1OljlZwEFvOXY0k_3Nw)|
|4|SHOW COLLATION|显示全部字符序,SHOW     COLLATION     [  LIKE     '  *pattern*  '     |     WHERE     *expr*  ],过滤：SHOW COLLATION like 'latin1%';,SHOW COLLATION WHERE Charset = 'latin1';|无|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739c00b8970c2af4f533a7d/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..pPtqcigDTDoq4ACAd-fZCS6z1OljlZwEFvOXY0k_3Nw)|
|5|SHOW CREATE PROCEDURE `test`.`TEST_PRO`|显示存储过程的定义,SHOW     CREATE     PROCEDURE     *proc_name*|指定的用户    `DEFINER`    或有mysql.proc表的SELECT权限|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739c00ba1ad9a3311ddb8d1/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..pPtqcigDTDoq4ACAd-fZCS6z1OljlZwEFvOXY0k_3Nw),没有权限：,![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739c00ba1ad9a3311ddb8d4/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..pPtqcigDTDoq4ACAd-fZCS6z1OljlZwEFvOXY0k_3Nw)|
|6|SHOW CREATE VIEW `test_view`|显示视图的定义,SHOW     CREATE     VIEW     *view_name*|show view权限，以及select相关视图权限|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739c00b8970c2af4f533a7f/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..pPtqcigDTDoq4ACAd-fZCS6z1OljlZwEFvOXY0k_3Nw),没有权限：mysql> show create view test_db01.test_show_view;    
  ERROR 1142 (42000): SHOW VIEW command denied to user 'regress'@'localhost' for table 'test_show_view'|
|7|SHOW CREATE TABLE `test`.`test`|显示表定义,SHOW     CREATE     TABLE     *tbl_name*|具有表的select权限|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739c00ba1ad9a3311ddb8d5/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..pPtqcigDTDoq4ACAd-fZCS6z1OljlZwEFvOXY0k_3Nw)|
|8|SHOW CREATE DATABASE test|显示database定义，database同义词schema,SHOW     CREATE   {  DATABASE     |     SCHEMA  }   [  IF     NOT     EXISTS  ]     *db_name*|具有db的select权限|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739c00ba1ad9a3311ddb8d6/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..pPtqcigDTDoq4ACAd-fZCS6z1OljlZwEFvOXY0k_3Nw)|
|9|SHOW CREATE DATABASE   **IF NOT EXISTS**   `mysql`|显示database定义，包含if not exists|具有db的select权限|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739c00ba1ad9a3311ddb8d7/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..pPtqcigDTDoq4ACAd-fZCS6z1OljlZwEFvOXY0k_3Nw)|
|10|SHOW CREATE TRIGGER test1.TEST|显示触发器定义,SHOW     CREATE     TRIGGER     *trigger_name*|需要触发器及关联表的权限|create trigger test_show_trigger before insert on test_show for each row set @sum = @sum + new.c1;,![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739c00ba1ad9a3311ddb8d8/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..pPtqcigDTDoq4ACAd-fZCS6z1OljlZwEFvOXY0k_3Nw)|
|11|SHOW DATABASES|显示所有database,SHOW   {  DATABASES     |     SCHEMAS  }   [  LIKE     '  *pattern*  '     |     WHERE     *expr*  ]|无|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739c00b8970c2af4f533a83/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..pPtqcigDTDoq4ACAd-fZCS6z1OljlZwEFvOXY0k_3Nw)|
|12|SHOW ENGINES|显示存储引擎,SHOW     ENGINE     *engine_name*   {  STATUS     |     MUTEX  },status：状态信息,mutex：互斥、读写锁统计信息|需要特权     PROCESS|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739c00b8970c2af4f533a84/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..pPtqcigDTDoq4ACAd-fZCS6z1OljlZwEFvOXY0k_3Nw),SHOW     ENGINE   INNODB   MUTEX;,无权限：mysql> SHOW ENGINE INNODB STATUS;    
  ERROR 1227 (42000): Access denied; you need (at least one of) the PROCESS privilege(s) for this operation|
|13|show fields from `columns_priv`|显示表的字段定义信息（和SHOW COLUMNS FROM一致）,SHOW     [  FULL  ]   {  COLUMNS     |     FIELDS  }   {  FROM     |     IN  }   *tbl_name*     [  {  FROM     |     IN  }   *db_name*  ]     [  LIKE     '  *pattern*  '     |     WHERE     *expr*  ]|有列的权限|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739c00ca1ad9a3311ddb8db/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..pPtqcigDTDoq4ACAd-fZCS6z1OljlZwEFvOXY0k_3Nw)|
|14|SHOW FULL COLUMNS FROM `newtable`|显示表列的更多信息,  
,语法同上|有列的权限|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739c00c8970c2af4f533a86/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..pPtqcigDTDoq4ACAd-fZCS6z1OljlZwEFvOXY0k_3Nw)|
|15|SHOW FULL PROCESSLIST|显示会话列表信息,SHOW     [  FULL  ]     PROCESSLIST,不使用FULL关键字， SHOW PROCESSLIST则仅显示字段中每个语句的前 100 个字符|- PROCESS权限可以查询所有
- 非匿名用户可以访问用户相关线程信息
- 匿名用户无权限
|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739c00ca1ad9a3311ddb8dc/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..pPtqcigDTDoq4ACAd-fZCS6z1OljlZwEFvOXY0k_3Nw)|
|16|SHOW FULL TABLES FROM TEST1|显示数据库中完整表信息，多了类型,SHOW     [  FULL  ]     TABLES     [  {  FROM     |     IN  }   *db_name*  ]     [  LIKE     '  *pattern*  '     |     WHERE     *expr*  ]|只显示有权限的表信息|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739c00c8970c2af4f533a89/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..pPtqcigDTDoq4ACAd-fZCS6z1OljlZwEFvOXY0k_3Nw)|
|17|SHOW FULL TABLES WHERE Table_type = 'VIEW'|显示数据库中完整表信息，  **带过滤**|同上|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739c00ca1ad9a3311ddb8dd/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..pPtqcigDTDoq4ACAd-fZCS6z1OljlZwEFvOXY0k_3Nw)|
|18|SHOW FULL TABLES FROM test1 WHERE Tables_in_test1 = 'newtable'|显示数据库中完整表信息，  **带过滤**|同上|略|
|19|SHOW FUNCTION STATUS WHERE Db = 'test'|显示数据库上的function信息,SHOW     FUNCTION     STATUS     [  LIKE     '  *pattern*  '     |     WHERE     *expr*  ]|所有者或select     `mysql.proc`    表权限|略|
|20|SHOW PROCEDURE STATUS WHERE Db = 'test'|显示数据库上的存储过程信息,SHOW     PROCEDURE     STATUS     [  LIKE     '  *pattern*  '     |     WHERE     *expr*  ]|所有者或select     `mysql.proc`    表权限|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739c00c8970c2af4f533a8c/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..pPtqcigDTDoq4ACAd-fZCS6z1OljlZwEFvOXY0k_3Nw)|
|21|SHOW PROCESSLIST|显示会话进程信息（和带full没有差异，#15）,SHOW     [  FULL  ]     PROCESSLIST|同#15|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739c00ca1ad9a3311ddb8e1/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..pPtqcigDTDoq4ACAd-fZCS6z1OljlZwEFvOXY0k_3Nw)|
|22|SHOW INDEX FROM `newtable`|显示表上的索引信息,SHOW   {  INDEX     |     INDEXES     |     KEYS  }   {  FROM     |     IN  }   *tbl_name*     [  {  FROM     |     IN  }   *db_name*  ]     [  WHERE     *expr*  ]|表的select权限|create index test_show_idx01 on test_show c1;,![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739c00c8970c2af4f533a8d/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..pPtqcigDTDoq4ACAd-fZCS6z1OljlZwEFvOXY0k_3Nw)|
|23|SHOW GLOBAL STATUS|显示全局状态信息    
  SHOW     [  GLOBAL     |     SESSION  ]     STATUS     [  LIKE     '  *pattern*  '     |     WHERE     *expr*  ]|无，能连接服务器|略，项目较多，与INFORMATION_SCHEMA GLOBAL_STATUS表内容一致|
|24|SHOW GLOBAL VARIABLES|显示全局系统变量,SHOW     [  GLOBAL     |     SESSION  ]     VARIABLES     [  LIKE     '  *pattern*  '     |     WHERE     *expr*  ]|无，能连接服务器|略（同show variables）|
|25|SHOW GRANTS FOR 'yasdb'@'192.168.132.53'|显示用户权限,SHOW     GRANTS     [  FOR     *user*  ]|具有select mysql系统数据库的|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739c00c8970c2af4f533a8f/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..pPtqcigDTDoq4ACAd-fZCS6z1OljlZwEFvOXY0k_3Nw)|
|26|SHOW MASTER STATUS|显示主服务器的复制状态,SHOW     MASTER     STATUS|SUPER或 REPLICATION CLIENT特权|  [show-master-status](https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/5.7/en/show-master-status.html)  |
|27|SHOW PLUGINS|显示所有插件信息,SHOW     PLUGINS|无|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739c00c8970c2af4f533a91/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..pPtqcigDTDoq4ACAd-fZCS6z1OljlZwEFvOXY0k_3Nw)|
|28|SHOW TRIGGERS LIKE 'user'|显示触发器，带过滤条件,SHOW     TRIGGERS     [  {  FROM     |     IN  }   *db_name*  ]     [  LIKE     '  *pattern*  '     |     WHERE     *expr*  ]|有数据库及表的权限|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739c00c8970c2af4f533a92/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..pPtqcigDTDoq4ACAd-fZCS6z1OljlZwEFvOXY0k_3Nw)|
|29|SHOW TABLE STATUS|显示所有表详细信息  **（包含视图）**,SHOW     TABLE     STATUS     [  {  FROM     |     IN  }   *db_name*  ]     [  LIKE     '  *pattern*  '     |     WHERE     *expr*  ]|有数据库及表的权限|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739c00c8970c2af4f533a93/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..pPtqcigDTDoq4ACAd-fZCS6z1OljlZwEFvOXY0k_3Nw)|
|30|SHOW STATUS|显示服务端状态信息（会话）,SHOW     [  GLOBAL     |     SESSION  ]     STATUS     [  LIKE     '  *pattern*  '     |     WHERE     *expr*  ]|无，能连接服务器即可|略，项目较多，与INFORMATION_SCHEMA SESSION_STATUS内容一致,- 使用    `SESSION`    修饰符时，该语句显示当前连接的状态变量值。如果变量没有会话值，则显示全局值。
- 没有修饰符，则默认值为       `SESSION`  
- local是session的同义词，show local status=show session status
|
|31|SHOW SLAVE STATUS|显示副本(备机)状态,SHOW     SLAVE     STATUS     [  FOR     CHANNEL     *channel*  ]|SUPER或 REPLICATION CLIENT特权|  [show-slave-status](https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/5.7/en/show-slave-status.html)  |
|32|SHOW TABLES|显示所有表名,SHOW     [  FULL  ]     TABLES     [  {  FROM     |     IN  }   *db_name*  ]     [  LIKE     '  *pattern*  '     |     WHERE     *expr*  ]|有表和视图权限|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739c00ca1ad9a3311ddb8e5/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..pPtqcigDTDoq4ACAd-fZCS6z1OljlZwEFvOXY0k_3Nw),  
|
|33|SHOW TABLE STATUS LIKE|显示所有表详细信息，带过滤条件|同#29|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739c00c8970c2af4f533a94/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..pPtqcigDTDoq4ACAd-fZCS6z1OljlZwEFvOXY0k_3Nw)|
|34|SHOW TABLE STATUS FROM test|显示特定database下的表信息|同#29|SHOW TABLE STATUS FROM test_db01;|
|35|SHOW TABLE STATUS FROM test1 LIKE 'newtable'|显示特定database下的表信息，带过滤条件|同#29|SHOW TABLE STATUS FROM test_db01 like '%show%';|
|36|SHOW VARIABLES|显示全部系统变量,SHOW     [  GLOBAL     |     SESSION  ]     VARIABLES     [  LIKE     '  *pattern*  '     |     WHERE     *expr*  ]|无|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739c00ca1ad9a3311ddb8e8/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..pPtqcigDTDoq4ACAd-fZCS6z1OljlZwEFvOXY0k_3Nw)|
|37|SHOW VARIABLES LIKE 'lower_case_table_names'|显示系统变量，带过滤条件|无|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739c00c8970c2af4f533a95/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..pPtqcigDTDoq4ACAd-fZCS6z1OljlZwEFvOXY0k_3Nw)|
|38|SELECT CURRENT_USER();|当前用户，  **内置函数**|NA|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739c00ca1ad9a3311ddb8e9/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..pPtqcigDTDoq4ACAd-fZCS6z1OljlZwEFvOXY0k_3Nw)|
|39|SELECT DATABASE()|当前database，  **内置函数**|NA|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739c00da1ad9a3311ddb8eb/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..pPtqcigDTDoq4ACAd-fZCS6z1OljlZwEFvOXY0k_3Nw)|
